questions.question: What does a high probability for the next token establish?
options: The token is true in the external world
The token is a likely continuation given the model, retained context, and decoding setup
The token appears in the training corpus
A verifier approved the claim
questions.explanation: A next-token probability ranks continuations under a conditional distribution. It is not independent evidence that a claim is true.

questions.question: A decisive source excerpt is truncated out of the context window. What is the most direct consequence?
options: The model can still directly attend to the excerpt
Temperature becomes zero
That excerpt cannot directly influence the next-token calculation
The tokenizer restores the missing source
questions.explanation: The model's next-token computation uses the tokens retained in its context. Text outside the window is not directly available to attention.

questions.question: What does raising temperature do to a fixed set of logits?
options: It adds new evidence to the prompt
It usually flattens the probability distribution and raises sampling diversity
It guarantees a factual answer
It increases the context window
questions.explanation: Temperature rescales logits before softmax. A higher temperature generally makes the distribution less concentrated; it does not verify content.

questions.question: Why can top-p sampling change an answer even when the prompt and model are unchanged?
options: It permanently updates model weights
It removes low-ranked probability mass and samples from the remaining normalized candidates
It retrieves new documents
It gives every vocabulary token the same probability
questions.explanation: Top-p forms a candidate set from cumulative probability mass and renormalizes it. Sampling can then choose different allowed continuations.

questions.question: For an MoE model with eight experts where each token activates two, which statement is accurate?
options: Only two experts need to be stored
All expert weights are free because only two are active
Active compute can be lower than total stored capacity, but routing and weight memory still matter
The router makes all tokens deterministic and factual
questions.explanation: Sparse routing reduces the active path per token, while stored weights, expert placement, and routing overhead remain operational concerns.

questions.question: Which signal most directly helps detect a long-context serving memory risk?
options: KV-cache utilization together with input lengths and concurrent sequences
Only total model parameter count
The number of prompt templates in source control
A single offline accuracy score
questions.explanation: KV-cache memory grows with active sequences and context length. Parameter count alone cannot reveal this request-dependent pressure.
